lines.en: The cocoon sways beneath the leaf.
The wind turns it half around.
The silk line tightens, then slackens.
It taps the leaf edge and rebounds.
It swings back and forth on the twig.

lines.zh: 它顺着一阵风滑了些位置
lines.en: A gust shifts it along the branch.

lines.zh: 茧壳随着摆动磨着叶面
lines.en: The shell rubs the leaf as it swings.
A raindrop weighs it down.
Then it slowly lifts again.

lines.zh: 它在树影里晃出一小片光
lines.en: It sways a small patch of light.
It can only shift so far.

lines.zh: 它安静地随着枝条起伏
lines.en: It rides the branch's rise and fall.

lines.zh: 它被同伴的丝牵了一下
lines.en: Another's thread tugs at it.
The swinging slows to a stop.
It settles back to its angle.
Only the wind can move it.
The cocoon hangs perfectly still.
Something stirs inside now and then.
Fine fuzz coats the shell.

lines.zh: 阳光透过叶片照在茧上
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the leaf onto it.

lines.zh: 它的颜色和枯叶很接近
lines.en: Its colour is close to a dead leaf.

lines.zh: 丝线在光里几乎看不见
lines.en: The silk is nearly invisible in the light.

lines.zh: 茧的一头轻轻颤了一下
lines.en: One end quivers once.
Whatever is inside changes position.
It bulges slightly.
And then goes quiet.
Rain strikes the shell and slides off.

lines.zh: 它像一个封好的小包裹
lines.en: It looks like a sealed little parcel.

lines.zh: 茧就在你眼前，一动不动
lines.en: The cocoon hangs before you, unmoving.
Your breath makes it sway.

lines.zh: 近看能看见丝线的走向
lines.en: Up close the silk's weave is visible.
Something dark shows through.

lines.zh: 你一动，它跟着摆了一下
lines.en: You move; it swings in answer.
It has no eyes to look back.

lines.zh: 它只是挂在那里，任你打量
lines.en: It simply hangs there for your inspection.
A fine seam runs along the shell.
You reach out; it rotates away.
It looks ready to split open.
Touched, the cocoon swings wildly.
A crease appears on the shell.

lines.zh: 里面的东西乱动了一阵
lines.en: The thing inside thrashes.
One thread snaps.
It hangs at a slant now.
It spins several times before stopping.
A little moisture seeps out.
The stirring inside weakens.

lines.zh: 它还是挂在原处，没有掉
lines.en: It still hangs, not fallen.
It can only wait; it cannot flee.

lines.zh: 茧对食物没有任何反应
lines.en: The cocoon shows no interest in food.

lines.zh: 它只是被你的手带得晃了晃
lines.en: It only sways from your hand's motion.
Something moves inside.
It is very light in your palm.
It neither eats nor drinks.
You set it back on the leaf's underside.
It finds its balance again.
The silk takes up the weight.
It gives no sign of anything.
It needs only time and quiet.
You touch the cocoon and it spins.
It bumps your knuckle and rebounds.
The thread stretches a little.
It swings harder than before.
You steady it until it stops.

lines.zh: 壳面上留下一小块印子
lines.en: A small mark stays on the shell.
It drifts back to where it was.
The stirring inside pauses.

lines.zh: 然后它继续原来的节奏
lines.en: Then it resumes its rhythm.
The cocoon is unchanged.

lines.zh: 两个茧挂在同一根枝上
lines.en: Two cocoons hang on one branch.
When the wind comes, they swing together.

lines.zh: 它们的丝线几乎并到一起
lines.en: Their threads almost run as one.
One moves and the other follows.

lines.zh: 它们在光里是两个暗点
lines.en: They are two dark spots in the light.
The branch bows under their weight.
Their shells differ in shade.
Both are excessively quiet.
Two fingers' width lies between them.

lines.zh: 明天也许就只剩空壳了
lines.en: Tomorrow there may be only empty shells.
Lifted, the cocoon does not resist.

lines.zh: 它在你手里几乎没有重量
lines.en: It weighs almost nothing in your hand.

lines.zh: 你能感觉到里面的轻颤
lines.en: You can feel a faint tremor inside.
It is moved beneath another leaf.
The silk takes hold again.
It sways twice before steadying.
You set it right and step back.

lines.zh: 它挂在那里，像没被碰过
lines.en: It hangs as if untouched.
Whatever is inside goes quiet too.
Now it belongs to this tree.
The shape inside turns toward you.
The silk pulls suddenly taut.
A small bump rises on the shell.
It presses toward your side of the shell.
The cocoon begins to rock.

lines.zh: 里面的东西动得越来越急
lines.en: The thing inside moves faster and faster.
A fine split opens along the shell.
A little moisture seeps out.
It has sensed the heat of you.
The whole cocoon trembles.

lines.zh: 茧还挂在原处，只是更薄了
lines.en: The cocoon still hangs there, thinner now.

lines.zh: 里面的影子在慢慢移动
lines.en: A shape shifts slowly inside.

lines.zh: 它贴着壳壁转了个方向
lines.en: It turns against the shell wall.
The shell darkens.

lines.zh: 里面的东西一阵一阵地动
lines.en: The thing inside moves in waves.

lines.zh: 每次动，茧就轻轻跳一下
lines.en: Each movement makes it hop.
It is looking for the thinnest point.

lines.zh: 它的头一直对着同一处
lines.en: Its head stays against one spot.

lines.zh: 壳面上出现了一个小凸起
lines.en: A small bump rises on the shell.
It tries, again and again.
The cocoon bumps your hand, lightly.
Its shell edge scrapes you.

lines.zh: 它摆动时碰到了你的脸
lines.en: Its swing brings it against your face.
Something inside shoves hard.
A little fluid spatters from the shell.
It recoils and swings back.
The silk catches it and holds.
A thin line appears on your hand.
It is all reflex, nothing more.
It hangs still again.

lines.zh: 一片叶子底下多了个茧
lines.en: A cocoon has appeared under a leaf.

lines.zh: 它是被丝一点点织出来的
lines.en: It has been spun, thread by thread.
The silk looks white in the morning light.
It hangs there, swaying with the wind.
The leaf bows under its weight.
Its colour matches the leaf's underside.
It hangs motionless, as if asleep.
When the wind stops, so does it.
You can hear the leaves rustle.
It hides well in the tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得变色，丝线先断
lines.en: Heat discolours the shell; the silk breaks first.

lines.zh: 掉在地上，壳磕出一声闷响
lines.en: It hits the ground with a dull knock.
Soaked, it slowly grows heavy.

lines.zh: 冲击把它掀飞，丝线全断
lines.en: The blast tears it free, silk snapping.

lines.zh: 箭穿过茧，把它钉在叶上
lines.en: An arrow pins it to the leaf.

lines.zh: 怪力钻进壳里，里面一阵乱撞
lines.en: Odd force enters; the inside thrashes.

lines.zh: 茧内干瘪下去，轻得反常
lines.en: It shrivels thin and weighs strangely little.
Lightning blows a corner of the shell open.

lines.zh: 虚空把丝线一根根抽走
lines.en: The void strips the threads away one by one.
